answer: Asset gain refers to capability increases that result from combining an AI model with special assets not available to the original model developers or testers. These assets can include government-held expertise (e.g., advanced propulsion, stealth technology, nuclear physics), specialized hardware (e.g., physical embodiments, sensors, actuators), or classified data (e.g., undisclosed software vulnerabilities, data on non-public or enhanced pathogens, or sovereign decryption keys). For instance, using the model with classified weaponization protocols or within a sophisticated, government-only cyber range could unlock dangerous CBRN or cyber capabilities.
